distribution: Public single-player edition: enterprise integration, backend and private platform configuration excluded.
scope: Grouped runtime art/code assets and retained source references; not a file-by-file license or dependency inventory.
policy: Original procedural Three.js meshes and seeded canvas surfaces; no GTA V extracted assets.

assets.notes: New generic cafe, scrambler and sport designs. Original CAD GLBs remain in public/models only as source references.

Male/female jaw and cheek contours, continuous female jacket shaping, eyelids and lips, five-finger hands, 17 compatible control joints and riding IK. Old GLB is a reference, not the runtime base. Not AAA photorealistic or a fully skinned body.
Coastal urban, desert and alpine variations with infrastructure and graded shoulders.
Asphalt, concrete, leather, soil and typographic road signs generated locally at runtime.
Nitro cylinder, shield plate, missile and mine. Missile has a pointed long body, four fins and nozzle; the projectile reuses this geometry.
Three retained wrap PNGs, three music tracks and engine/weather samples. Retention does not establish redistribution rights. No media downloaded in this documentation update.
Shared male/female profile; 4 face bases, 12 face and 10 body sliders; draft/save/cancel, undo, compare, full-body/face views and subtle idle motion.
Continuous bob hair curtain and low ponytail with tie; not strand hair. Hidden with the head under helmet preview.
YX-01 matte faceted shell, cyan visor strip, chin armor and red rear light; shared by male and female riders.
Local halos, rings, narrow exhaust, flowing boost chevrons and trigger lights; no added fullscreen Bloom. Default road layout has 12 boost pads and 14 obstacle groups.
World-space thin rain lines, random gradual non-snow showers and retained alpine snow; not wet-road tire physics.
Mode/garage/route flow, navy/magenta/cyan HUD, neutral amber character studio.
